citation.authors: Reilly DM, Kynaston L, Naseem S, Proudman E, Laceby D

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.population: Adults taking a hydrolysed collagen plus vitamin C supplement, daily or every 48 hours (number not given in the abstract)
record.finding: At 12 weeks the supplement group had better skin hydration and elasticity. The number of hairs counted rose 27.6% against placebo, which was not statistically significant (p not significant); the rating for healthy hair appearance rose 31.9% (p<0.01).
record.note: A branded product that also contains vitamin C. Participant number, skin type and funding not in the abstract.
